title: origin.md — YAML frontmatter
$comment: Frontmatter of origin.md. The body is the creator's words and is never capped or summarized. Its sections are '## Context & Motivation' (required and non-empty; the tool checks this at creation), then optionally '## Scope', '## Constraints' and '## Completion criteria'. The original body is never rewritten: `revise` appends dated sections under '## Revisions', and `reanchor` keeps the earlier origin as origin-N.md and replaces this file.

title.description: Human title; the slug is derived from it. One line.

parent.description: Set on subthreads. A subthread's origin covers its own work and may mention the parent for context.

from-task.description: Set when the thread was promoted from a task on the parent's list.

previous.description: The immediately preceding origin retained beside origin.md after reanchor.

supersedes.description: Legacy pointer from the retired supersede command; never written now.

namespace.description: Optional label for keeping threads apart, e.g. per agent. Absent means the default namespace. Ids stay unique across the whole store. A thread lives at <ns>/threads/<id>-<slug>/ (archived: <ns>/threads/archived/YYYY-MM/<id>-<slug>/), and this field must agree with the folder.

project.description: Opaque tag. Projects aren't a primitive yet.
